error.detail: proof: a light QUEUED read (project.current, normally ~3ms) has been unanswered for 3.4s, while a recent BYPASS read document.current succeeded. Queued reads remain stalled after schematic.component.place (req_4916). Next step: wait — the daemon re-checks by itself and this refusal stops the moment the queue drains.
